```{r, setup, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(magrittr)
library(driveanalytics)

knitr::opts_knit$set(echo = FALSE)

# Get the render format
render_format <- knitr::opts_knit$get('rmarkdown.pandoc.to')
if (render_format == "") render_format <- "html"
```

## Overview

This module produces simple demographic characteristics tables showing numbers, sex, ethnicity and age at cohort entry, per cohort.

## Considerations and Limitations
* The difference between periods and patients is for the case where an individual patient occurs multiple times in a given cohort. This happens if, for example, the cohort has been defined as periods of time in PICU and a patient has been re-admitted.
* Note that the ethnicity are aggregated to the categories in the [NHS data dictionary](https://www.datadictionary.nhs.uk/data_elements/ethnic_category.html)
* If you are seeing 0 years for age at entry, then it is because your cohort entry is defined at birth

## Example
The following demographic characteristics table is based on two randomly generated cohorts.

For cohort A, it can be seen that:

1. There are 517 periods of data across 405 patients
1. 48.36 % are female, the rest are male
1. The mixed ethnicity category is the most common at 24.37 %
1. The median age at cohort entry is 7.17 years

```{r, example, echo=FALSE, dpi=200, out.width="100%", fig.dim = c(8, 3)}
# Create a random sample of patients in two cohorts and assign random events
set.seed(123)
n <- 1000
df_pde <- tibble::tibble(
  project_id = sample(1:n, n, replace = TRUE),
  cohort_id = project_id,
  cohort = sample(c("A","B"), n, replace = TRUE),
  sex_name = sample(c("Male","Female"), n, replace = TRUE),
  birth_date = lubridate::as_date(sample(as.Date("2000-1-1"):as.Date("2010-1-1"), n, replace = TRUE)),
  ethnicity_nat_code = sample(c(LETTERS[1:8], LETTERS[10:14], "P", "R", "S", "Z"), n, replace = TRUE),
  cohort_entry_date = lubridate::as_date(sample(as.Date("2010-1-1"):as.Date("2015-1-1"), n, replace = TRUE)),
  cohort_exit_date = lubridate::as_date(sample(as.Date("2015-1-1"):as.Date("2020-1-1"), n, replace = TRUE)),
)

# Perform frequency analysis and get results
coh_char <- driveanalytics::pde_cohort_characteristics(df_pde)
tabulate(coh_char, render_format)
```
